message:
Well, it looks like we’re in for a little stormy weather this week. I always see these moments as a perfect excuse to hunker down with a good book and a warm cup of tea—preferably while the wind does its best to rattle the windows. 😊

I found a handy resource on flood safety from the National Weather Service that’s great for brushing up on what to do before, during, and after a storm. It’s a cozy reminder to be prepared so we can enjoy the sounds of nature’s orchestra without any worries.

What’s your go-to cozy activity when the weather gets a bit stormy?
